verdicts.quote: “OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user.”
verdicts.reason: The Management API natively supports OAuth2 specifically for third‑party apps managing users’ orgs/projects, which is the right flow for a multi‑tenant agent.

verdicts.quote: “In your organization's settings, navigate to the OAuth Apps tab… click Add application.”
verdicts.reason: OAuth apps are created self‑serve in the dashboard; Supabase also offers a Free plan with API usage, so devs can obtain working creds without review or sales.

verdicts.quote: “The Envoy API gateway sits in front of 7 services: GoTrue, PostgREST, Realtime, Storage, pg_meta, Functions, and pg_graphql.”
verdicts.reason: Multiple first‑party APIs (data REST/GraphQL, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Functions, plus Management) indicate broad product coverage.

verdicts.quote: “Connect your AI tools using the official Supabase Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.”
verdicts.reason: Supabase publishes and maintains an official MCP server.

verdicts.quote: “There are two ways to generate an access token: 1. Personal access token (PAT)… 2. OAuth2…”
verdicts.reason: Self‑serve PATs and OAuth2, with full docs and no stated app review or partner gate, make it buildable today.
